title: MOF Chain Token provenance credential prototype
description: Synthetic, non-financial prototype package accompanying Paper 1. It demonstrates contribution-schema design, non-financial MCT reputation-score simulation, metadata-style verification, and a non-transferable credential stub. It is not a deployed blockchain or financial token system.
